verdict.rationale: The first-party docs contain no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only related evidence is community material. That includes forks and scripts that strip telemetry, which are user-side workarounds. It also includes config keys ([telemetry] trace_upload=false, [features] telemetry=false) that a user explicitly called unverified because they got them by asking the CLI itself. The 'Improve the model' toggle is an adjacent training-data control, and a wire-level analysis reportedly found it has no effect on uploads. None of this is a documented product opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
